body:
sqlb/auth/filesystem use database/sql; the skill and ubgo/lock use pgx. Recommendation: database/sql through sqlb for one code path on SQLite/Postgres/MySQL; pgx-only extras (LISTEN/NOTIFY wake-ups) in an optional sqlstore/pgnotify module.

Decided 2026-10-11: database/sql through ubgo/sqlb (sqlstore uses it; pgx is used only as a database/sql driver).
title: Decide: database/sql via sqlb vs pgx for the SQL store
